content.value: Draw state diagram and design the control unit with JK flip-flops for the following operations (13) where n varies from 0 to 3 and G is a two bit sequence register.

$$
x T _ { n } : G \gets G + 1 ; ~ y T _ { n } : G \gets G - 1 ; ~ x ^ { \prime } y ^ { \prime } T _ { n } : G \gets 0 0
$$
